title: Written Order and Prior Authorization Terms, Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program
content:
The Documentation and Prior Authorization unit works the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program to the following tier terms.

| Tier | Written order validity (calendar months from the order date) | Prior authorization required | Prior authorization validity period (calendar months from the payer decision date) | Renewal lead time (calendar days before the valid-through date) | Standard decision time (calendar days from the request date) | Expedited decision time (hours from submission) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | 12 | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | 12 | Yes | 6 | 30 | 15 | 72 |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | 12 | Yes | 12 | 30 | 15 | 72 |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | 12 | Yes | 12 | 30 | 7 | 72 |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | 12 | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| CGM Medicaid Program | 12 | Yes | 6 | 21 | 7 | 72 |

## Meaning of the figures

- **Written order validity** is the validity of the prescriber's written order, counted in calendar months from its order date.
- **Prior authorization required** states whether the payer requires prior authorization before this product line ships.
- **Prior authorization validity period** runs in calendar months from the payer decision date, unless the payer's approval states an earlier valid-through date; 0 means no prior authorization on the tier.
- **Renewal lead time** is the earliest point for submitting a prior authorization renewal, in calendar days before the valid-through date of the authorization being renewed; 0 means no prior authorization on the tier.
- **Standard and expedited decision times** are the payer's decision times for a standard request (calendar days from the request date) and an expedited request (hours from submission); 0 means no prior authorization.

## Reading across the tiers

- Two tiers carry no prior authorization at all: the CGM Self-Pay Program and the CGM Original Medicare Program; every prior-authorization figure on those tiers is 0.
- The CGM Medicaid Program has the shortest renewal lead time (21 days); the other prior-authorization tiers allow 30.
- Every tier gives the written order the same 12-month validity.
